user.title: Add Degree Dealer
user.description:
Degree Dealer learns how your house uses district heating and advises a supply temperature, a return temperature target and a night setback that pays off.

This version only calculates and advises; it does not control anything yet.

plant.title: Heating plant
plant.description: The sensors of your heating controller, and what it can control. Directly connected district heating can usually only limit the return temperature; a mixing loop, heat exchanger, boiler or heat pump controls the supply.

data_description.supply_temperature_entity_id: Measured supply (flow) temperature to the radiators.
data_description.return_temperature_entity_id: Measured return temperature from the radiators.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity_id: Outdoor temperature sensor. Either this or a weather entity is required.
data_description.weather_entity_id: Used for the outdoor temperature when no outdoor sensor is chosen.
data_description.control_mode: Decides which advice Degree Dealer gives.
data_description.return_limit_entity_id: The controller's current return limit (e.g. the return temperature reference). The advice is relative to it; without it the measured return is used. Only for return limit control.
data_description.return_limit_min_temperature: The advice never goes below this.
data_description.return_limit_max_temperature: The advice never goes above this.
data_description.supply_reference_entity_id: The supply temperature the controller is aiming for. The advice is relative to it; without it the measured supply is used. Only for supply control.
data_description.supply_min_temperature: The advice never goes below this (supply control).
data_description.supply_max_temperature: The advice never goes above this (supply control).

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Choose the areas with heated rooms. The next pages show what was found in each area, so you can check and adjust it.

room.title: Room: {room}
room.description: Found in **{room}**. Check the entities and adjust them if needed. A room needs at least a thermostat or a temperature sensor.

data_description.climate_entity_ids: Radiator thermostats or other climate entities in the room.
data_description.temperature_entity_ids: The mean is used as the room temperature. Without them the thermostats' own temperature is used.
data_description.valve_entity_ids: Sensors with valve opening or heating demand in percent (0-100 %). The highest is used. Without them the thermostats' heating/idle state is used.
data_description.opening_entity_ids: While one is open the room pauses learning and does not decide the supply temperature.
data_description.motion_entity_ids: Shows whether the room is in use (used for room setbacks later).
data_description.humidity_entity_ids: Shown with the room (used for mould protection later).
data_description.exclude_from_supply: Turn on for rooms that should not decide the advice (supply or return limit), e.g. a bathroom with floor heating or a room that is always cold.

meter.title: Meter data
meter.description: Optional data from your heat meter or utility. It is used to learn how much heat the house loses per degree.

data_description.heat_energy_entity_id: Sensor with the meter reading in Wh, kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ (a total that increases).
data_description.meter_lag_days: Days the meter readings arrive late. 0 for a local meter, often 1 for data from the utility.
data_description.expected_return_entity_id: The return temperature your utility expects. Used as the target instead of the fixed value.
data_description.target_return_temperature: Used when no expected return temperature is chosen.

economy.title: Economy and setback
economy.description: Prices and limits for the night setback. Prices are in your Home Assistant currency.

data_description.heat_price: Your variable price per kWh of heat including taxes.
data_description.return_penalty: Extra cost per K return temperature per MWh (motivation tariff). 0 if your utility has none.
data_description.recovery_return_rise: How many K the return temperature rises while the house heats back up after a setback.
data_description.min_saving: A setback is only advised when it saves at least this per night.
data_description.min_room_temperature: The setback never lets the rooms go below this (mould and comfort).
data_description.max_setback: Largest setback in K below the comfort temperature.
data_description.night_end: The rooms must be back at comfort temperature at this time.
data_description.manual_heat_loss_coefficient: 0 to learn it from the meter data. Set it if you have no meter data or know the value.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Degree Dealer can add a dashboard to the sidebar with the advice, supply and return, the night setback, the house model and one section per room. You can edit it in the UI.

data.dashboard: Show the dashboard in the sidebar

error.same_entity: Supply and return must be different sensors.
error.outdoor_required: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity.
error.room_empty: Choose at least one thermostat or temperature sensor.
